name: truncated-collection-footer
title: Truncated collection footer
description: Presentation-only summary of a loaded first cursor page without a total or pager. N+ is a lower bound when hasMore is true; the note explains that more items exist. Compose below data-table (DataTable with paginated={false}). First-page recipe: use hasMore={true} for N+ plus a note, and supply noteId so a consumer table can reference it with aria-describedby. DataTable does not forward aria-describedby; its named containing region can reference the note instead. Count-only recipe: use hasMore={false} for the visible count without a note. PageToolbar has no count prop; this block carries the count. No navigation or focusable elements. Every visible string is overridable through noun, summaryLabel, formatCount and truncationNote; ReactNode overrides must remain plain text without interactive or hidden content. The i18n provider supplies translated defaults; locale overrides number formatting. Required inputs are visibleCount and hasMore, with meaningful runtime defaults for the JavaScript catalogue preview.
author: gntik-ai

files.content:
/** Meaningful runtime defaults for the JavaScript catalogue preview. */
export const TRUNCATED_COLLECTION_PREVIEW = { visibleCount: 37, hasMore: false } as const;
